text_en: Finally, my brothers and sisters, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you is not troublesome to me, and for you it is a safeguard.
text_cn: 此外，我的弟兄们！你们应喜乐于主；给你们写一样的事，为我并不烦难，为你们却是安全。

text_en: Beware of the dogs, beware of the evil workers, beware of those who mutilate the flesh!
text_cn: 你们要提防狗，要提防邪恶的工人，要提防自行割切的人。

text_en: For it is we who are the circumcision, who worship in the Spirit of God and boast in Christ Jesus and have no confidence in the flesh—
text_cn: 其实，真受割损的人是我们，因为我们是以天主的圣神实行敬礼，在耶稣基督内自豪，而不信赖外表的人，

text_en: even though I, too, have reason for confidence in the flesh. If anyone else has reason to be confident in the flesh, I have more:
text_cn: 虽然我对外表也有可信赖的。如果有人以为自己能将信赖放在外表上，那我更可以：

text_en: circumcised on the eighth day, a member of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew born of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
text_cn: 我生后第八天受了割损，出于以色列民族，属于本雅明支派，是由希伯来人所生的希伯来人；就法律说，我是法利塞人；

text_en: as to zeal, a persecutor of the church; as to righteousness under the law, blameless.
text_cn: 就热忱说，我曾迫害过教会；就法律的正义说，是无瑕可指的。

text_en: Yet whatever gains I had, these I have come to regard as loss because of Christ.
text_cn: 凡以前对我有利益的事，我如今为了基督，都看作是损失。

text_en: More than that, I regard everything as loss because of the surpassing value of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. For his sake I have suffered the loss of all things, and I regard them as rubbish, in order that I may gain Christ
text_cn: 不但如此，而且我将一切都看作损失，因为我只以认识我主基督耶稣为至宝；为了他，我自愿损失一切，拿一切当废物，为赚得基督，

text_en: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own that comes from the law, but one that comes through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God based on faith.
text_cn: 为结合于他，并非藉我因守法律获得的正义，而是借由于信仰基督获得的正义，即出于天主而本于信德的正义。

text_en: I want to know Christ and the power of his resurrection and the sharing of his sufferings by becoming like him in his death,
text_cn: 我只愿认识基督和他复活的德能，参与他的苦难，相似他的死，

text_en: if somehow I may attain the resurrection from the dead.
text_cn: 我希望也得到由死者中的复活。

text_en: Not that I have already obtained this or have already reached the goal; but I press on to make it my own, because Christ Jesus has made me his own.
text_cn: 这并不是说：我已经达到这目标，或已成为成全的人；我只顾向前跑，看看是否我也能够夺得，因为基督耶稣已夺得了我。

text_en: Beloved, I do not consider that I have made it my own; but this one thing I do: forgetting what lies behind and straining forward to what lies ahead,
text_cn: 弟兄们！我并不以为我已经夺得，我只顾一件事：即忘尽我背后的，只向在我前面的奔驰，

text_en: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the heavenly call of God in Christ Jesus.
text_cn: 为达到目标，为争取天主在基督耶稣内召我向上争夺的奖品。

text_en: Let those of us then who are mature be of the same mind; and if you think differently about anything, this too God will reveal to you.
text_cn: 所以，我们凡是成熟的人，都应怀有这种心情；即使你们另有别种心情，天主也要将这种心情启示给你们。

text_en: Only let us hold fast to what we have attained.
text_cn: 但是，不拘我们已达到什么程度，仍应照样进行。

text_en: Brothers and sisters, join in imitating me, and observe those who live according to the example you have in us.
text_cn: 弟兄们！你们要一同效法我，也要注意那些按我们的表样生活行动的人，

text_en: For many live as enemies of the cross of Christ; I have often told you of them, and now I tell you even with tears.
text_cn: 因为有许多人，我曾多次对你们说过，如今再含泪对你们说：他们行事为人，是基督十字架的敌人；

text_en: Their end is destruction; their god is the belly; and their glory is in their shame; their minds are set on earthly things.
text_cn: 他们的结局是丧亡，他们的天主是肚腹，以羞辱为光荣，只思念地上的事。

text_en: But our citizenship is in heaven, and it is from there that we are expecting a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 至于我们，我们的家乡原是在天上，我们等待主耶稣基督我们的救主从那里降来，

text_en: He will transform the body of our humiliation that it may be conformed to the body of his glory, by the power that also enables him to make all things subject to himself.
text_cn: 他必要按他能使一切屈服于自己的大能，改变我们卑贱的身体，相似他光荣的身体。
